title: TrafficLight class with state
statement: Define a TrafficLight class with a parameterless constructor that starts at state 0 (red), a Next method that advances to the next state (0, 1, 2 and back to 0), and a State method that returns the current state. Read how many times to advance, create the object, advance that many times and write the final state.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
